lore.text: The sheer bond between Adamastor and Urdar has manifested itself into a physical form due to their duress. Such power is not to be abused...
An auxiliary power core of the powerful TERA-4M Mining robot line. It controls the robots by giving the bearer a compulsion to break new grounds and progress further without heed.
One of Skien's many deadly weapons. This warhammer, despite the massive weight of the hammerhead, was able to be swung by Skien fast enough to be a blur.
Wielded by the chief of the Tromsian jungle's zombie tribes, the augmentable crystals within it focus natural elemental energies to intense levels.
Carried by the Durum Protector, this small necklace holds but an ounce of the vibrance and life of the Durum Isles.
The fabled weapon of the titular dark Assassin, the blade's small stature hides its true powers. Shadows undulate about the hilt.
The weapon of the fearsome lone bandit, Rymek Luke, it is unique in that it is designed to fire small metal rounds instead of more traditional projectiles.

lore.text: Carried by the Olux Plague Doctor, this simple-looking stick subtly oozes with an unidentifiable substance that is invigorating to the holder, and lethally venomous to anything else.

description.text: Poisoned mobs spread their poison to nearby mobs.

lore.text: Crafted exclusively by the Temple of the Legends' mages, this stave is honorary to Mages who best the Temple's Grand Magus.
An oppressively dark aura emanates from this shackle, dampening both the will and magic potency of those that wear it.
The name has got to be misspelled... It doesn't even make any sense!
If it weren't for that stray mark, this would be spelled correctly...
This item was named by someone from the community!
Let its whispers guide your hand, and let nothing but a scar of resentment remain.

description.text: Violent Vortex applies 2 marks to every enemy it hits.
Exploding gives an additional chance to deal
Main Attack damage in a radius of 5 blocks upon killing an enemy.

lore.text: "They tear the earth open day after day after day, ripping out her most precious and vital stones, and dumping them into the abyss of their hungry, bottomless coffers. They would sell out the world for a bit of cash; after all, these stones bleed green."

description.text: Picking up emeralds heals you and nearby players for 8% max health.

lore.text: Dwarven folklore tells of this mighty maul, used by gods to break mountains, shape continents, and crack the earth to form caverns.

description.text: Bash gains +1 Area of Effect and is 0.05s faster.

lore.text: No one knows how this extremely dense chestplate can even logically exist. It is almost paradoxical in nature, and affects its wearers in unfathomable ways.

description.text: Pulls items dropped by mobs towards you.

lore.text: If you reach for ammunition from your quiver, as long as you have a single arrow, you will find you never run out.

description.text: Arrow Hurricane becomes a consistent, straight stream of arrows with a slower fire rate, dealing greater knockback and triple damage per arrow. Additionally, Arsenal Synergy requires 10 less arrows for each flint arrow.

lore.text: A deep regret stains this weapon-once a healing implement of the scholar-priest, its gentle power was turned and twisted as his ideals and resolve were tested, and faltered. With its wielder long passed, perhaps it can finally be absolved of the atrocities committed by his hand... and remember the peace it has long forgotten.

Soul-locking magic is one outlawed by Gavellian governments, only used by the most insidious and cruel of mages. One such enchantment looms dormant in this mundane-looking maul. Continued usage of the weapon threatens to release it upon the wielder, permanently binding them to the weapon.

The last known crafts of Theorick before his fall in battle were pieces of armour crafted out of pure ice, all of which have melted save for these shimmering boots. The coldest gales and most suffocating heat nurture and repair the wearer instead of being stifling or deadly.

The unwieldy, yet imposing stature of this massive sickle strikes awe into those who view it. Those who have the will to wield it, however, seem to garner respect from all those around them, as though they had become a god.

Mysterious runes, held by inexplicable ancient guardians, were once moulded together for study purposes. The experiment went awry, as the runic words Nii, Az, and Ek were combined in a reaction that resulted in the collapse of a civilization.
Wealth and riches...but at what cost?
A mage by the name of Lero claims to have harnessed the sheer power of lightning using a magical staff, however, the weapon is very unreliable in a pinch.

description.text: Judrajim no longer ramps in damage after each hit. When it expires, it releases 115% of its potential in an explosion of 20 blocks.

lore.text: "The lightest light will never defeat the darkest dark. Only those who understand both can survive."
You will probably irreversibly harm yourself with this, but when has that ever stopped you?

description.text: Totem effects are twice as fast, but duration is halved.
Cleansing Breeze heals you for 15% and allies for 20%, but Charge becomes harmless.
